OpenAI just declared a full Code Red, and it’s way bigger than the headlines make it sound. In this video, I break down what the internal memo really says, why OpenAI suddenly went into panic mode, and how competitors like Google’s Gemini and Anthropic pushed them here.

items.title: Reduce CONTEXT for MAX Intelligence. WHY?
items.summary:
Advanced visual Ai reasoning? It is simple: create a synthetic "adversarial" environment inside the inference process of the reasoning engine. No additional training runs. 

And: AI Test Time Scaling (TTS) algorithm claim advanced reasoning performance for your AI, but is it true? And what AI Scaling method should you pay for? Self-refinement? Self-Reflection? Best-of-N? 
There is a new TTS competitor with outstanding performance features. Maximal reduction of the visual representation for the training accuracy of next generation Visual AI systems. You can implement it today.

Anyway: Both advances in AI visual and textual reasoning come from constraining the complex mathematical search space: either by anchoring logic with a dummy answer (Verify First) or by anchoring vision with coordinate sparsity (Visual CoT). 

All rights w/ authors:
Asking LLMs to Verify First is Almost Free Lunch
Shiguang Wu, Quanming Yao
from
Department of Electonic Engineering
Tsinghua University

items.title: The dark side of entrepreneurship no one warns you about
items.summary:
Entrepreneurship looks like freedom from the outside. Build what you want, work when you want, travel whenever. And yes, that part is real. But there’s also a dark side that people rarely talk about.

My friend @ShawhinTalebi felt it right after transitioning from his technical role at Toyota into full-time entrepreneurship. The freedom is incredible… but the loneliness hits harder than expected. The deeper you go, the fewer people truly relate to your goals, your problems, or the mix of technical and business decisions you now live with every day.

As a technical founder, it’s even more intense. You no longer have that “army of engineers” to bounce ideas with. Your old friends might not get the technical side, and very few understand the business side. You become this strange in-between alien navigating both worlds alone.

It’s not talked about enough, and if you go down this path, you need to know it’s part of the journey. The freedom is amazing, but it comes with a cost.

I’m Louis-François, PhD dropout, now CTO & co-founder at Towards AI. Follow me for tomorrow’s no-BS AI roundup 🚀

#entrepreneurship #founderlife #startuplife

items.title: Structured Data Retrieval with Sparrow using OCR and Vision LLM [Improved Accuracy]
items.summary:
I explain improvements I'm adding into Sparrow to achieve better accuracy for structured data. I'm using a method, where I run OCR step first, then construct advanced prompt with injected OCR data. This prompt is sent along with image to Vision LLM for structured data retrieval. All this happens as part of a single pipeline.

Sparrow GitHub repo:
https://github.com/katanaml/sparrow

Try Sparrow:
https://sparrow.katanaml.io
